I've only noticed this happening with existing friends. Rejoining doesn't help, nor does disabling or enabling voice or avatar. Also tried restarting both VRChat and SteamVR.
When it occurred: 
* I was on a Vive Pro, my friend on an Index
* He could hear me and see my visimes; I couldn't hear him, nor see his visimes
* Neither of us could see each others' animations or blendshapes
Aware of this issue and actively working on it! Thanks for the info.

Beta ongoing which trying to fix this issue.
Select any beta branch to test out without leaving friends on live branch (to be same instance and visible each others).
現在、betaでこの問題のパッチを試験運用中。
世界線の変更なしでテスト可能。
2つとも同じ内容。
This *should* be improved with 1005. Please let me know if you still are having problems.

This happened to me. When I got on after the update yesterday, _none_ of my existing friends could hear me, but non-friends (and new friends) were able to hear me. 
These are the things I tried to fix the issue:
- Changed avatars
- Rejoined world
- Tried with different friends
- Restarted VRC
- Restarted SteamVR
- Restarted computer

Build 1008 still having that problem and we ware face to the related new case..
I know that they are talking by "Voice icon" is showing on the theirs nameplate.
But i can't listen to everybody voice.
以前としてBuild1008で前述の問題が継続している上に、関連する新たなケースに陥りました。
ネームプレート上を見る限りボイスアイコンが表示されているので喋っていることは分かるのですが、全員の声が聞こえない状態です。

I don't know if this is the same issue but sound def. cuts to space sounding or too low to hear at random times. Normally comes back after a bit. Sometimes when muting un-muting. Hard to know if that does anything.
It still happens even after the latest update

details:
Occurred on VRChat 2020.4.1.
We'll suddenly stop hearing some players' voices that we're in any instance of the world after just join. (I guess I think of PlayerAudioOverride has problem)
We has been confirmed that to be able repaired this problem by the person of talking side will be restarting or changing theirs avatar.
but in some case still has problem after try that's procedure.

ワールドにしばらく滞在していると、突然一部のプレイヤーの声が聞こえなくなります。
声を出す側がVRCの再起動もしくはアバターを変えることで聞こえるようになることが確認はできています。
が、その手順を試してもまだ問題が続く場合があります
上記の英文は友人協力の元作成しています。
title: [1004]The player's voice suddenly stops being heard.
